surface.name: watsonx.ai as a Service text chat REST API
surface.selection_basis: IBM's service API documents regional endpoints, IAM bearer authentication, project-scoped model input, and a text-chat response.

alternatives_considered.name: watsonx.ai Python library
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: The REST reference reaches the response boundary without a language-specific client.

alternatives_considered.name: watsonx.ai software
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: The software API is a distinct deployment and administration boundary.

entry_point.developer_intent: Configure IBM Cloud watsonx.ai access and receive model output from the text-chat REST API.
assumed_prior_state: No IBM Cloud project, service access, IAM token, or model configuration exists.
A browser and cURL are available.

documented_first_success.normalized_outcome: An authenticated, project-scoped watsonx.ai text-chat request returns generated assistant content.
documented_first_success.observable_completion_signal: The HTTP 200 response contains a choices array with an assistant message.

boundary_evidence.official_label_or_terminal_state: The API reference documents POST /ml/v1/text/chat and a successful response with assistant content.

documented_first_success.why_this_is_the_boundary: The returned assistant content is the first meaningful model result. IBM Cloud project, region, IAM, and service access are included because they are present in the request contract.

prerequisites.requirement: An IBM Cloud account with watsonx.ai as a Service access.
An IBM Cloud project ID and supported regional endpoint.
IAM roles that authorize the inference action.
An IBM Cloud IAM access token.

primary_path.action: Create or sign in to IBM Cloud and provision access to watsonx.ai as a Service.
primary_path.input: IBM Cloud account and service choices
primary_path.success_signal: The service and project console are reachable.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Account, region, plan, or organization policy can block access.

primary_path.action: Create or select a project and note its project ID and region.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Project creation permissions can block setup.

primary_path.action: Obtain an IBM Cloud IAM access token with the required role.
primary_path.success_signal: A token is available for the regional endpoint.

primary_path.action: POST model_id, project_id, messages, and parameters to /ml/v1/text/chat with a version date.
primary_path.input: Region, token, project, model, and messages
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Authentication, permission, project, model, version, or quota errors block output.

primary_path.action: Confirm a generated assistant message is present in choices.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: An error body or missing choice is not first success.

friction_gates.description: watsonx.ai as a Service access is required.
Project and region identifiers are required.
IAM access and an unexpired bearer token are required.

uncertainties.question: Which current plan and service-provisioning steps are universally available to a new IBM Cloud account?
uncertainties.impact: Could add billing, trial, or approval gates.
uncertainties.reason_unresolved: The API reference specifies the request contract but not the full new-account provisioning UI.
